pages.ja:
夜明けと共に、石室は輪郭を顕わにした。
天井から差し込む光が地下の闇を薄めていく。
入り口という入り口、窓という窓には封が施されているが、そんなもので陽の侵入は防げまい。
本来闇に閉ざされるべきこの場所でも、夜明けとなれば陽の恩恵が下されるのだから。

pages.en:
At dawn, the stone chamber reveals its contours.

Light filtering from the ceiling thins the darkness underground.

Every entrance and every window has been sealed, but such measures cannot keep out the sun.

Even this place, meant by its nature to remain enclosed in darkness, receives the grace of daylight when morning comes.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The stone room is illuminated by the morning sun.
The light coming in from the ceiling pushes back the darkness.
Every entrance and every window is sealed off, but even that cannot block out the sunlight.
Even the place that should be covered in darkness benefits from the break of dawn.

pages.ja:
入り口であれ窓であれ、もとより何かを出入りさせる為のものだ。
蓋をしたところで隙間が埋まる筈もなし、何より、それでは通路としての用をなさない。
日の光から完全に逃れたいというのなら、初めから入り口などあってはならない。
闇を好むのならば地中に、後戻りできぬ地の底に潜るべきだ。

pages.en:
A door or window exists, from the first, to admit something or let it pass outside.

No lid can close every gap. More importantly, once sealed, the opening no longer serves as a passage.

Anyone who wishes to escape sunlight completely should build no entrance at all.

Those who love the dark should burrow into the earth—to a depth from which there can be no return.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Entrances and windows are ordinarily used to let things enter and leave.
The cracks cannot be covered, and besides, if it is entirely closed off, it cannot fulfill its duty to be used as a passage.
If one wants to completely shut out the light, there should not be any entrances.
If one prefers darkness, one should go to an underground place without a way to return.

pages.ja:
その点で言えば、この地下聖堂も完璧とは言えない。
日の光は無遠慮に秘密を露わにする。
隠された聖堂は容易く発見され、やはり同じ程度の容易さで、その主を失った。
床には血の跡がある。
この聖堂の本来の持ち主は、侵入者によって倒された。
聖杯戦争の監督役である言峰綺礼は、キャスターの手にかかって退場したのだ。

その点で言えば、この地下聖堂も完璧とは言えない。

pages.en:
In that respect, this underground sanctuary is not perfect either.

Sunlight exposes secrets without the slightest restraint.

The hidden chapel was discovered with ease, and with equal ease deprived of its master.

There is blood upon the floor.

The rightful owner of this place was defeated by an intruder.

Kirei Kotomine, overseer of the Holy Grail War, has left the stage at Caster's hand.
pages.mirrorMoon:
In that regard, this underground temple is not perfect.
Light exposes all secrets without reservation.
The hidden temple was easily discovered, and its master was easily eliminated as well.
There are traces of blood on the floor.
The original owner of this temple was killed by an intruder.
The supervisor of the Holy Grail War, Kotomine Kirei, was removed from the stage by Caster’s hand.

pages.en: “Gh… ah, hah…………——”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Kuh…… ah, hah……”

pages.ja:
その戦いも、既に数時間前の話である。
地下は静寂を取り戻した。
教会の新たな主となった彼女は、その闇の中で佇んでいる。
だが、勝利者である彼女は自らを蔑んでいた。
口元を苛立たせたまま、キャスターは闇を睨む。
pages.jaRuby:
その戦いも、既に数時間前の話である。
地下は静寂を取り戻した。
教会の新たな主となった彼女は、その闇の中で佇んでいる。
だが、勝利者である彼女は自らを[ruby text=さげす]蔑んでいた。
口元を苛立たせたまま、キャスターは闇を睨む。
pages.en:
That battle ended hours ago.

Silence has returned underground.

The woman who became the church's new mistress stands amid the darkness.

Yet despite her victory, she regards herself with contempt.

Irritation twisting her mouth, Caster glares into the dark.
pages.mirrorMoon:
That battle happened a few hours ago.
The underground regained its silence.
The new master of the church is standing in the darkness.
But the winner scorns herself.
Caster glares at the darkness with an irritated look.

pages.ja:
まず、この聖堂が気に入らない。
隠された聖域も、この聖域が隠す更なる聖域も趣味に合わない。
侵入む明かりも不快であるし、先ほど始末した神父も気に入らなかった。
そして何より、最も重要な目的が未だ果たせていないとはどういう事か。
彼女は事の不出来さに呆れ、いっそこの場を灰燼に帰そうとさえ憤った。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
First, she dislikes this sanctuary.

Neither the hidden holy ground nor the deeper sanctum concealed within it suits her taste.

The light intruding upon it is offensive. So was the priest she disposed of earlier.

And above all, how can her most important objective remain unfulfilled?

Disgusted by the failure of the entire affair, she burns with the urge to reduce the place to ashes.
pages.mirrorMoon:
First of all, this temple is unpleasant.
Neither the sanctuary nor the secret sanctuary hidden beneath it suit her taste.
The intruding light is unpleasant, and the priest she killed was unpleasant as well.
And most importantly, the crucial objective has not been accomplished yet.
She is shocked at how poorly things are going, and she even considers reducing this whole place to ashes.

pages.en: “Hh——hah…………ah.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Fu, haa…… ah.”

pages.ja:
幸い、その凶行は取り止められた。
冷静さを取り戻したからではないし、教会に対する敬意の念などからでもない。
pages.jaRuby:
幸い、その凶行は取り止められた。
冷静さを取り戻したからではないし、教会に対する敬意の念などからでもない。
pages.en:
Fortunately, she has refrained from that outrage.

Not because her composure returned, nor from any reverence for the church.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Fortunately, she refrains from such violence.
It is not because she regained her composure, nor is it because of respect towards the church.

pages.ja:
彼女が感情を抑えたのは、偏にこの音があるからだ。
定期的に漏れる、囁くような雑音。
苦しげに漏れる女の声は、彼女にとって天上の楽曲に等しい。
それが今しばらく、この享楽を続けさせているだけだった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
She restrains herself for this sound alone.

A whispered noise escaping at regular intervals.

The suffering woman's voice is heavenly music to Caster.

For a little longer, it alone persuades her to prolong this pleasure.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She suppressed her emotion only because of this sound.
Faint, periodic sounds.
A woman’s painful voice is like fine music to her.
She forgets her troubles and enjoys the spectacle.

苦痛に呻く声は、紛れもなく少女のものだ。
口元から漏れる声はあまりにも弱々しい。
苦悶は聞く者に保護欲か、相反する嗜虐心を抱かせる。
無論、彼女は後者だ。
ぽたり、と少女の額から零れる汗。

pages.en:
The voice moaning in pain belongs unmistakably to a girl.

What escapes her lips is painfully faint.

Such suffering might inspire in the listener either a desire to protect or its opposite, the appetite for cruelty.

Caster, naturally, feels the latter.

A bead of sweat falls from the girl's brow.

Merely watching those delicate lips endure their agony seems to raise the temperature of this cold chamber.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The groaning sounds of pain come from a girl.
The weak murmur contains heated arousal.
Her murmur is very weak.
The groans would inspire either compassion or sadistic pleasure in those who may hear them.
It does not need to be said that she falls under the latter category.
Sweat drips down her forehead.
Just watching the beautiful lips, gasping in
shame,
agony,
seems to bring heat to this cold room.

Moreover, a binding spell powerful enough to become visible torments Saber's entire body.

The Command Spell crushes her from within, while Caster's magecraft assails her from without.

Worse still, a magic so strong that it is visible tortures Saber’s body.
The Command Spell pressures her from the inside and Caster’s magic tortures her from the outside.
The torture is more unbearable than having her body wounded.

それでも、最後に残った誇りが彼女を保たせていた。
令呪の縛めもキャスターの魔術も、その根底だけは奪えない。

pages.en:
Saber's reason is close to vanishing.

Even so, the last remnant of her pride sustains her.

Neither the Command Spell's shackles nor Caster's magecraft can steal that foundation from her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saber’s reasoning has almost disappeared.
Only the last remnants of her pride hold her back.
Neither the Command Spell nor Caster’s magic can take away that deep root.

pages.ja:
故に責め苦は永遠に続く。
その過程
必死に踏みとどまる少女を、キャスターは愉しげに眺めていた。
白い装束で着飾らせたのは彼女の趣向だ。
無骨な鎧ではそそらないし、なにより少女には似合わない。
汚れを知らない聖女ならば、堕ちる時こそ純白のドレスで飾るべきだろう。

故に責め苦は永遠に続く。

pages.en:
And so the torment goes on and on.

Caster watches in delight as the girl struggles desperately to hold her ground.

The white dress was a touch of Caster's own devising.

The crude armor inspired nothing in her, and more importantly, did not suit the girl.

When an immaculate saint is made to fall, surely she ought to be adorned in a dress of purest white.

It is not arousing with her armor, and most of all, the armor does not suit her.

virgin,
saint,
she should be in a pure white dress when she falls.

いくら貴女の意思が拒み続けても、サーヴァントとして作られたその体は別よ。
令呪が少しずつ侵食しているのが判るでしょう？ 貴女はあと一日も経たずに私のモノになる。なら、もう降参して素直になった方が楽じゃなくて？」

pages.en:
“…Hee hee. How brave of you.

“Your will may continue to refuse me, but the body fashioned for you as a Servant is another matter.

“You can feel the Command Spell consuming it by degrees, can you not? In less than a day, you will belong to me. Would it not be easier to surrender now and accept what you are?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Fufu. How brave of you.
No matter how much you resist with your will, that Servant body of yours is different.
You can tell that the Command Spell is slowly infringing on your mind, right? You will be mine in less than a day. In that case, is it not easier to give up now and become mine?”

“Gh——nn…………!”

Her voice strains in painful resistance.

Though her reason has begun to melt, Saber will not yield to Caster.

Just as Caster says, she will endure this torture until the final instant when the Command Spell takes possession of her body.

As Caster says, she will endure this torture until the Command Spell fully controls her body.

私、貴女みたいな娘は好きよ。金の髪も小さな体も、少年のような凛々しさも可愛いわ。それに、裏切るぐらいなら死を選ぶ一途さも愛らしい。
本当、踏み潰してあげたいぐらい」

pages.en:
“How stubborn you are, Saber. …But yes, I forgive you.

“I am fond of girls like you. Your golden hair, your little body, that gallantry of yours almost like a boy's—all so charming. Even your single-minded preference for death over betrayal is adorable.

“——Truly, you make me want to crush you beneath my heel.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You are stubborn, Saber. …But I shall forgive you.
I like girls like you. That golden hair, small body, the boyish gallant figure, everything is so cute. And I love your loyalty for trying to choose death over betrayal.
Really, I want to step on you and crush you.”

pages.ja:
憎しみと愉悦が混じった目で少女を見つめる。
キャスターがその気になれば、セイバーの陥落など一瞬だ。
セイバーは一つの令呪を抑えるだけで自由を奪われている。
ならば、続けて二つ目の令呪で追い詰めれば結果は明白だ。
このような責め苦を負わせるまでもなくセイバーはキャスターの物になるだろう。

pages.en:
She regards the girl with eyes in which hatred and delight mingle.

If Caster wished it, Saber's fall would take only an instant.

Resisting one Command Spell has already deprived Saber of her freedom.

If Caster drove her farther with a second, the result would be inevitable.

Saber would become hers without any need for this torment.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She looks at the girl with eyes filled with joy and hatred.
If Caster put her mind to it, she could get Saber to surrender in an instant.
Saber’s freedom is lost from fighting one Command Spell.
Then, the result is obvious if Caster uses a second Command Spell.
Saber will become Caster’s without the need for such torture.

training
finishing
her, since she is a lovely toy.

あなたには自分から私のサーヴァントになってもらいましょう。……ええ。体ではなく、先に心を壊してあげる」
最強の駒は手中に収めたに等しい。
もはや彼女の勝利を脅かすものはない。

pages.en:
“…Yes. Controlling your body with a Command Spell would be terribly dull.

“You will choose to become my Servant of your own accord. …Yes. Before I break your body, I shall break your heart.”

The strongest piece is already as good as hers.

Nothing now threatens her victory.

The Holy Grail's whereabouts remain a concern, but only a matter of time. Her lips curve as she prepares to enjoy the fall of the King of Knights, her reward for every intrigue.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Yes. It is boring to control your body using the Command Spell.
I will have you become my Servant out of your own will. …Yes, I will destroy your mind before your body.”
Caster glares with bewitching eyes at the girl in the white dress.
She almost forgets about the Holy Grail. She thinks about Saber’s white skin and imagines transforming her into a slave that only seeks pleasure.

pages.ja:
「そこで何をしている、キャスター」
不意に。背後から、感情のない声がかけられた。
pages.jaRuby:

不意に。背後から、感情のない声がかけられた。
pages.en:
“What are you doing there, Caster?”

Without warning, an emotionless voice addresses her from behind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What are you doing there, Caster?”
An unemotional voice suddenly calls her from behind.

pages.ja:
「
！？」
咄嗟に振り返る。
聖堂の上。
地上に通じる階段を、何者かがゆっくりと下りてくる。
薄闇に浮かび上がるのは、幽鬼のような痩躯だ。
足音もなく気配もない。
床に続く血痕、磔にされた少女を前にして、男は無表情のまま聖堂に降り立った。

「
！？」

pages.en:
“——!?”

She wheels around.

High above the chapel,

someone is slowly descending the stairs that lead to the surface.

A gaunt figure like a ghost emerges from the gloom.

He makes no sound and gives off no presence.

With the trail of blood and the crucified girl before him, the man descends into the sanctuary without expression.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!?”
She turns around immediately.
Above the temple…
Someone slowly comes down the stairs that lead outside.
A tall, lean figure appears from the darkness.
There is no sound of footsteps, nor is there any presence to be felt.
The man comes down into the temple and shows no emotion even after seeing the blood on the ground and the girl.

pages.ja:
「
宗一郎、様」
キャスターの気配が一変する。
苛立ちと愉悦という相反する感情に酔っていた姿が、引き締められたサーヴァントの貌になる。
pages.jaRuby:

宗一郎、様」

pages.en:
“——Lord Souichirou.”

Caster's bearing transforms.

The figure intoxicated by the opposing pleasures of irritation and delight vanishes, replaced by the disciplined countenance of a Servant.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Souichirou-sama.”
Caster changes her attitude right away.
Her expression changes from one filled with joy and irritation to that of a tense Servant.

pages.ja:
「何故ここに……？ 貴方には柳洞寺にいるよう、お願いした筈ですが」
「質問は私が先だキャスター。ここで何をしている、と訊いたのだが」
pages.jaRuby:
「何故ここに……？ 貴方には柳洞寺にいるよう、お願いした筈ですが」
「質問は私が先だキャスター。ここで何をしている、と訊いたのだが」
pages.en:
“Why are you here…? I believe I asked you to remain at Ryuudou Temple.”

“I asked first, Caster. What are you doing here?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Why are you here…? I believe I asked you to stay at the Ryuudou Temple.”
“I questioned you first, Caster. I asked you what you are doing here.”

pages.ja:
男
葛木宗一郎の声に変化はない。
抑揚のない声は、その実どのような恫喝よりも心を圧迫する。
感情のない声は鏡と同じだ。
罪の意識。
後ろめたいものがある者ほど、この声に畏れを抱く。
葛木という人物にではなく、自分自身に問いつめられるのだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The man's voice——Souichirou Kuzuki's voice——does not change.

Its lack of inflection presses upon the heart more heavily than any threat.

An emotionless voice is a mirror.

The guilty,

those with something to hide, fear it most.

It is not Kuzuki who interrogates them, but their own reflection.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The manKuzuki Souichirou does not change the tone of his voice.
The flat voice is more terrifying than any threat.
A voice without emotion is like a mirror.
A guilty conscience.
The voice is more fearful to those with greater guilt.
One is questioned not by Kuzuki, but by one’s own mind.

pages.ja:
「っ
」
胸を押えながら、キャスターは一部始終を報告する。
偽証など通じる相手ではない。
否、この相手にだけは、偽りを口にする訳にはいかなかった。
pages.jaRuby:

」

否、この相手にだけは、偽りを口にする訳にはいかなかった。
pages.en:
“——”

Pressing a hand to her breast, Caster reports everything that happened.

Deception would not serve against this man.

No—even if it might, he alone is someone to whom she cannot speak falsely.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
Caster holds her hands on her chest and reports to Kuzuki.
He is not one that can be fooled.
No, she cannot bear to tell a lie to this person.

pages.ja: 「昨日、マスターの一人である衛宮士郎からサーヴァントを奪いました。……衛宮士郎は逃がしましたが、既にマスターではありません。賢明な人間ならば、私たちに刃向かう事はないでしょう」
pages.jaRuby: 「[ruby text=さくじつ char=2]昨日、マスターの一人である衛宮士郎からサーヴァントを奪いました。……衛宮士郎は逃がしましたが、既にマスターではありません。賢明な人間ならば、私たちに刃向かう事はないでしょう」
pages.en: “Yesterday, I took a Servant from one of the Masters, Shirou Emiya. …I allowed Shirou Emiya himself to escape, but he is no longer a Master. If he possesses any wisdom, he will not oppose us again.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “I have taken away a Servant last night from one of the Masters, Emiya Shirou. …I let Emiya Shirou go, but he is no longer a Master. If he is smart, he should not oppose us anymore.”

pages.ja:
「そうか。だが、そんな指示を下してはいない」
「私の独断です、マスター。
その後、聖杯の“器”を手に入れる為に教会を襲いました。聖杯の管理役である神父は仕留めましたが、聖杯の行方は不明です」
「そちらも独断か。帰還しなかったのは聖杯が見つからなかったからだな。……ふむ。たしかに折角手に入れた場所だ。肝心の物を手に入れないまま留守にしては意味がない」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“I see. But I gave you no such instruction.”

“I acted upon my own judgment, Master.

“Afterward, I attacked the church to obtain the Holy Grail's *vessel*. I disposed of the priest who oversaw it, but the Grail's whereabouts remain unknown.”

“That too was your own decision. You did not return because you failed to find the Grail. …Hm. It is a place you went to some trouble to seize. There would be little point in leaving it unattended before obtaining the object that matters.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. But I have not given such an order.”
“I acted arbitrarily, Master.
After that, I attacked the church to obtain the ‘vessel’ of the Holy Grail. I have killed the priest, the caretaker of the Holy Grail, but the Grail’s whereabouts are unknown.”
“That was your decision as well, huh? You must not have returned because you could not find the Holy Grail. …Hm. But it is a place you obtained after much trouble. It would be meaningless to abandon it without finding what you are after.”

pages.ja:
葛木の言葉は、何を責めている訳でもない。
が、キャスターは己を恥じるしかなかった。
聖杯の行方を知る神父を殺したものの、未だ聖杯を手に入れていない。
加えて、隠し通さねばならない独断さえ明らかにしてしまった。これを失態と言わずなんと言おう。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Kuzuki's words contain no reproach.

Even so, Caster can do nothing but feel ashamed.

She killed the priest who knew the Holy Grail's whereabouts, yet still does not possess it.

Worse, she has confessed the very acts of independence she was meant to conceal. What can this be called if not failure?
pages.mirrorMoon:
Kuzuki’s words are not criticizing her.
But Caster can only be ashamed of herself.
She killed the priest who knew where the Holy Grail was, but she still does not have the Holy Grail.
Furthermore, she has revealed her own action which should have been hidden from him. What else can she call it but a total failure?

pages.ja:
「状況は判った。理由を説明できるか、キャスター」
「……申し訳ありません。ですが、これも全てマスターの為。私の目的は貴方を勝利させる事だけです。理由など、それ以外にはありません」
「
」
長い沈黙。
強く断言したキャスターを前にして、そうか、とだけ葛木宗一郎は呟いた。

pages.en:
“I understand the situation. Can you explain your reasons, Caster?”

“…Forgive me. But all of it was done for you, Master. My sole purpose is to bring you victory. There is no other reason.”

“————”

A long silence.

Faced with Caster's vehement declaration, Souichirou Kuzuki murmurs only, “I see.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I understand the situation. Can you explain why you did this, Caster?”
“…I am sorry. But this is all for you, Master. My goal is to lead you to victory. I have no other reason.”
“”
A long silence.
After hearing Caster’s declaration, Kuzuki Souichirou murmurs, “I see”.

pages.ja:
「では、ここから離れる訳にはいかんな。留守中、他のマスターに聖杯を見つけられては、おまえの苦労も無駄になる」
「では、マスター」
「納得のいくまで調べるがいい。それまでは私もここに残ろう。おまえ一人では戦いに向かん。セイバーが手駒になるまで護衛は必要だろう」
pages.jaRuby:
「では、ここから離れる訳にはいかんな。留守中、他のマスターに聖杯を見つけられては、おまえの苦労も無駄になる」
「では、マスター」
「納得のいくまで調べるがいい。それまでは私もここに残ろう。おまえ一人では戦いに向かん。セイバーが手駒になるまで護衛は必要だろう」
pages.en:
“Then we cannot leave this place. If another Master finds the Holy Grail in our absence, all your effort will have been wasted.”

“Then, Master——”

“Search until you are satisfied. I will remain here until then. You are ill suited to battle alone. Until Saber becomes your pawn, you will require a guard.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Then I cannot move away from here. Your troubles will be for nothing if other Masters find the Holy Grail while we are absent.”
“Then, Master…”
“You can search this place until you are satisfied. I shall remain here until you are done. You alone are not fit for fighting. You will need a guard until Saber is under your control.”

pages.ja:
「え
い、いえ、それには及びません。マスターに力を借りずとも手駒はありますし、聖杯の探索とてどれほどかかるか。
それに、ここは危険です。柳洞寺に戻られた方が、貴方の身は安全です」
「正論だ。だが、それでは私の目的が果たせなくなる」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“What——n-no, that will not be necessary. I possess other pieces without calling upon your strength, and there is no telling how long the search for the Holy Grail may take.

“Besides, this place is dangerous. You will be safer if you return to Ryuudou Temple.”

“A sound argument. But then I would fail to accomplish my purpose.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh? N-No, there is no need for that. I do not need your help, and I do not know how long the search will take.
And this place is dangerous. You will be safer if you return to the Ryuudou Temple.”
“That is true. But if I do that, I cannot fulfill my objective.”

pages.ja:
「？」
その言葉は、キャスターにとって意外な一言だった。
目的などない、と。
願いを叶える聖杯にさえ興味がない、というこの男に、いったいどんな目的があるというのか。
pages.jaRuby:
「？」
その言葉は、キャスターにとって意外な一言だった。
目的などない、と。
願いを叶える聖杯にさえ興味がない、というこの男に、いったいどんな目的があるというのか。
pages.en:
“?”

The words take Caster entirely by surprise.

He has no purpose, he said.

This man claims no interest even in the wish-granting Holy Grail. What purpose can he possibly mean?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“?”
Those words are unexpected even for Caster.
What kind of an objective does this man have, who has no interest even in the Holy Grail which can grant any wish?

pages.ja:
「宗一郎様、それは」
「急げよ。無ければないでいい。成果は問わん。結果だけを出すがいい」
簡潔に告げて、葛木は階段へ戻っていく。
「
」
その姿を、キャスターは呆然と見上げた。
薄闇は変わらず静寂。
地上を目指していく足音は、やはり聞こえなかった。

pages.en:
“Lord Souichirou, what do you——”

“Hurry. If it is not here, then so be it. I do not demand success. I demand a conclusion.”

With that terse instruction, Kuzuki returns to the stairs.

“————”

Caster stares after him in astonishment.

The gloom remains silent.

As he climbs toward the surface, his footsteps once again make no sound.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Souichirou-sama, then…”
“Hurry. I do not care if it is not here. Just make sure you come up with a clear result.”
With that, Kuzuki goes back up the stairs.
“”
Caster watches him go in blank amazement.
The dark room is still silent.
The footsteps going up the stairs still cannot be heard.
